basic_info.description: Modern Bernal Heights home with breathtaking 360-degree roof deck! Built in 2018, this stylish residence spans 4 levels with 4 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, media room or gym, and living spaces designed for both comfort and style. The top floor kitchen/family room boasts a wall of windows framing views across the city to the Marin Headlands. A gourmet chef's kitchen is equipped with quartz countertops, sleek cabinetry, top-of-the-line appliances, and sliding doors to a fabulous front deck. Upstairs, a retractable skylight opens to reveal the show-stopping roof deckideal for entertaining! The 2nd level houses a laundry room, 2nd bedroom with ensuite bath, and a spacious primary suite with a walk-in closet, spa-like bath, and stunning city views. The entry level presents an expansive family room/3rd bed with a wall of closets and an ensuite bath. This space flows seamlessly to a decked garden, perfect for outdoor entertaining, and leads down to a serene patio. The lower floor includes a gym or media room with built-in cabinetry and a wet bar, alongside a spacious guest bedroom with garden access and an ensuite bath. Convenient 1-car garage. Ideally situated across from Bernal Heights Park and close to vibrant shops and dining options in Noe Valley, the Mission, and Bernal Heights.
